logline: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 2's confrontation at the altar, where Juliana publicly exposed Gerald's dishonor before the entire aristocratic congregation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Lady Juliana standing abandoned near the altar in her white gown, clutching her mother's medallion to her chest.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking, Spiteful)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Look at you...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the Lady in Gold Gown, smiling smugly in her gold gown beside Gerald.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Scornful)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: ...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of Juliana's hand tightly clutching the jeweled silver locket against her breast, tears welling in her eyes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana looking across at her sister with wounded pride.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Hurt, Bitter)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You stole my wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing together at the front of the nave.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Don't pretend you've earned anything.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown smirking derisively.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Smug, Malicious)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: I didn't steal what was never truly yours.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips, refusing to break down.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: This was my wedding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side medium shot of Gerald looking away impassively as the Lady in Gold Gown leans back against him.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Taunting, Cruel)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: It was supposed to be.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown beaming triumphantly.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Vindictive)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Now it is mine.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle wide shot of an imperious Noble Matriarch in a lavish black velvet gown and jeweled tiara stepping forward.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Harsh, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: Enough, Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Noble Matriarch glaring down with icy contempt.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cold, Disgusted)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: You have humiliated this family enough for one day.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, tears shimmering in her eyes as betrayal strikes deep.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Juliana as she speaks out against her family's injustice.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Pained, Betrayed)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I was humiliated by your family.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Accusing)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: And my father said nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch, completely unsympathetic.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Brutal, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: Your father has made his choice.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's stricken, vulnerable face.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Choked, Vulnerable)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: And what happens to me?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cold, Heartless)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: You leave.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Disbelieving)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Leave where?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cruel, Scornful)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: Wherever a discarded daughter belongs.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Fierce, Choked)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: This is my mother's church.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I have every right to stand here.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Venomous)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: Not anymore.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Stern, Final)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: Your father has chosen his family...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Coldly Severing)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: ...and it isn't you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Shouting, Imperious)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: Guards! Remove her!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Screaming, Resisting)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Let me go!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Begging)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Please! Someone!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The guards tear her grip away from the pew.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Low, Thunderous, Imposing)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Take your hands off her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Aggressive, Threatening)
segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
segments.text: Stand aside, stranger!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Deadly)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I said...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Dangerous, Uncompromising)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: ...let her go.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Frantic, Shouting)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Gentle, Protective)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Are you hurt?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Firm, Menacing)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Furious, Hysterical)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Deep, Resonant)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I can...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Stern, Accusing)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Gentle)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Affirming, Sincere)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: ...to remember your worth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Bewildered)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Why are you doing this?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Simple, Certain)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Because I want to.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Honorable, Earnest)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: You came here to become a wife.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Resolute)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: They took that from you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Earnest, Sincere)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I am offering it back.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Soft, Hesitant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You don't even know me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Steady)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I know enough.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Devoted)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Lady Juliana... accept my hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking down at him, fresh tears trailing down her flushed cheeks as a soft, trembling smile of hope touches her lips into a slow fade.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gazes down at her rugged savior, overcome with emotion as the swelling score holds on the cliffhanger.

segments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Gentle, Protective)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Are you hurt?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Firm, Menacing)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.

segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Furious, Hysterical)
segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
segments.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Deep, Resonant)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I can...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Stern, Accusing)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Gentle)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Affirming, Sincere)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: ...to remember your worth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Bewildered)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Why are you doing this?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Simple, Certain)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Because I want to.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Honorable, Earnest)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: You came here to become a wife.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Resolute)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: They took that from you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Earnest, Sincere)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I am offering it back.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Soft, Hesitant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You don't even know me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Steady)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: I know enough.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.

segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Devoted)
segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
segments.text: Lady Juliana... accept my hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking down at him, fresh tears trailing down her flushed cheeks as a soft, trembling smile of hope touches her lips into a slow fade.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gazes down at her rugged savior, overcome with emotion as the swelling score holds on the cliffhanger.
